scope: Bounded read-only cloud inventory using directory metadata, frozen receipts, and one sample shard; no full-data scan, parquet read, recomputation, or full rehash.

accepted_release.root_gate_copy_observation: The gate copy at the published-root top level was not present during this bounded audit; the accepted archived gate remains present under gate_v2_20261003.

reusable_evidence_contract.ad_status: Canonical row locator, date/geography metadata, parse/quality flags, and evidence counts.
reusable_evidence_contract.experience: Evidence offsets, object type, duration bounds, binding/relation, optionality, context, applicant-context flag, and requirement strength.
reusable_evidence_contract.technology: Evidence offsets, technology type/name, role, binding, ambiguity, context, and applicant-context flag.
reusable_evidence_contract.v6_audit: Education, qualification-scope, equivalence, negation, applicant-requirement, and related audit fields.
reusable_evidence_contract.cleaned_text_note: The inspected frozen schemas retain evidence context and exact offsets but do not expose a full cleaned-text column. Work requiring full cleaned text may need a separate existing source or a narrowly scoped derivation; this does not justify repeating the existing semantic extraction.

reuse_decision.qualification: A genuinely new engineering-patch field may require a narrow additive pass only if it cannot be derived from the frozen evidence, offsets, audit fields, or another retained text source.
